item.title: vLLM on K8S 部署与集群实战
item.description:
环境要求： Kubernetes 1.30+, vLLM 0.17.1, NVIDIA GPU Operator

学习目标

完成本指南的学习后，您将能够：

序号 学习目标 验收标准
1 理解vLLM on K8s架构 能说明各组件作用
2 配置存储（PV/PVC） 能创建模型存储卷
3 编写vLLM Deployment 能编写完整的Deployment YAML
4 配置Service 能暴露vLLM服务
5 部署多副本 能扩容vLLM实例
6 配置Ingress 能通过域名访问服务
7 完成滚动更新 能无中断升级服务

vLLM K8s基础部署

部署架构设计

vLLM on Kubernetes 架构

将vLLM部署到Kubernetes，需要以下组件：

 1
 2
 3
 4

10

vLLM on K8s 架构
├── 存储（Storage）
│   ├── PV - 模型文件持久卷
│   └── PVC - 模型存储声明
├── 工作负载（Workload）
│   └── Deployment - vLLM服务部署
├── 网络（Networking）
│   ├── Service - 内部服务发现
│   └── Ingress - 外部访问入口
├── 配置（Config）
│   ├── ConfigMap - 配置参数
│   └── Secret - 敏感信息
└── 资源（Resources）
    └── GPU - nvidia.com/gpu资源请求

部署方式对比

方式 优点 缺点 适用场景
单Pod 简单直接 无高可用 测试开发
Deployment 支持扩缩容、滚动更新 需要配置 生产环境
StatefulSet 稳定网络标识 复杂 有状态服务

本方案使用 Deployment 方式部署vLLM。

命名空间规划 

1
2
3
4

# 创建专用命名空间
kubectl create namespace llm-serving

# 查看命名空间
kubectl get namespace llm-serving

命名空间规划建议

命名空间 用途
gpu-operator GPU Operator组件
llm-serving LLM推理服务
monitoring 监控组件

存储配置

为什么需要持久化存储

问题：vLLM Pod重启后，模型文件会丢失吗？

答案：如果模型在容器内，重启会丢失。需要用持久化存储。

解决方案：

  1. 预先下载模型到共享存储
  2. 通过PVC挂载到Pod
  3. Pod重启后模型文件仍然存在

存储方案选择

存储类型 特点 适用场景
Local PV 性能最好，单节点 单节点部署
NFS 共享存储，多节点 多节点部署
Ceph 分布式存储，高可用 大规模生产

# local-pv.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: models-pv
spec:
  capacity:
    storage: 500Gi
  volumeMode: Filesystem
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
  storageClassName: local-storage
  local:
    path: /data/models  # 节点上的模型目录
  nodeAffinity:
    required:
      nodeSelectorTerms:
      - matchExpressions:
        - key: kubernetes.io/hostname
          operator: In
          values:
          - gpu-node-1  # 替换为你的GPU节点名

# vllm-deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: vllm-qwen-7b
  namespace: llm-serving
  labels:
    app: vllm
    model: qwen-7b
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: vllm
      model: qwen-7b
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: vllm
        model: qwen-7b
    spec:
      # 节点选择器（可选）
      nodeSelector:
        nvidia.com/gpu.present: "true"

      # 容器配置
      containers:
      - name: vllm
        image: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.17.1
        args:
        - --model
        - /models/Qwen2-7B-Instruct
        - --host
        - "0.0.0.0"
        - --port
        - "8000"
        - --trust-remote-code
        - --gpu-memory-utilization
        - "0.9"
        - --max-model-len
        - "4096"

        # 资源配置
        resources:
          limits:
            nvidia.com/gpu: 1
            memory: "16Gi"
            cpu: "4"
          requests:
            memory: "8Gi"
            cpu: "2"

        # 存储挂载
        volumeMounts:
        - name: models
          mountPath: /models

        # 端口配置
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8000
          name: http
          protocol: TCP

        # 健康检查
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: 8000
          initialDelaySeconds: 120  # 模型加载需要时间
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5

        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: 8000
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 5
          timeoutSeconds: 3

      # 存储卷
      volumes:
      - name: models
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: models-pvc

Service类型选择

类型 特点 适用场景
ClusterIP 仅集群内访问 内部服务调用
NodePort 通过节点端口暴露 测试环境
LoadBalancer 云厂商负载均衡 云上生产环境
ExternalName DNS别名 外部服务引用

4 Service ClusterIP暴露服务

多副本部署

# 手动扩容到3个副本
kubectl scale deployment vllm-qwen-7b --replicas=3 -n llm-serving

# 查看扩容结果
kubectl get pods -n llm-serving

# 输出示例
# NAME                           READY   STATUS
# vllm-qwen-7b-xxxxx-aaaa        1/1     Running
# vllm-qwen-7b-xxxxx-bbbb        1/1     Running
# vllm-qwen-7b-xxxxx-cccc        1/1     Running

💡 注意：每个副本需要1张GPU，3副本需要3张GPU。

Pod反亲和性配置

问题：3个副本可能调度到同一个节点，导致单点压力过大。

解决：使用Pod反亲和性，让Pod分散到不同节点。

      podAffinityTerm:
        labelSelector:
          matchLabels:
            app: vllm
            model: qwen-7b

资源规划

GPU需求计算

副本数 GPU需求 推荐配置
1 1张 1台GPU服务器
3 3张 3台GPU服务器 或 1台4卡服务器
5 5张 2台GPU服务器（3+2）

显存需求计算

1
2
3
4

单副本显存 = 模型大小 + KV Cache + 预留
7B FP16 ≈ 14GB + 4GB + 2GB = 20GB

推荐GPU：RTX 4090 (24GB) 或 A100 (40GB+)

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: vllm-config
  namespace: llm-serving
data:
  GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION: "0.9"
  MAX_MODEL_LEN: "4096"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: vllm-secret
  namespace: llm-serving
type: Opaque
stringData:
  API_KEY: "sk-xxxxx"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: vllm-qwen-7b
  namespace: llm-serving
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: vllm
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: vllm
    spec:
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
          - weight: 100
            podAffinityTerm:
              labelSelector:
                matchLabels:
                  app: vllm
              topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
      containers:
      - name: vllm
        image: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.17.1
        args:
        - --model
        - /models/Qwen2-7B-Instruct
        - --host
        - "0.0.0.0"
        - --port
        - "8000"
        - --trust-remote-code
        - --gpu-memory-utilization
        - $(GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION)
        - --max-model-len
        - $(MAX_MODEL_LEN)
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: vllm-config
        resources:
          limits:
            nvidia.com/gpu: 1
            memory: "16Gi"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: models
          mountPath: /models
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8000
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: 8000
          initialDelaySeconds: 120
      volumes:
      - name: models
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: models-pvc

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: vllm-ingress
  namespace: llm-serving
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout: "300"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-send-timeout: "300"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-body-size: "50m"
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  rules:
  - host: vllm.example.com  # 替换为你的域名
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: vllm-service
            port:
              number: 8000

# storage.yaml
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: models-pv
spec:
  capacity:
    storage: 500Gi
  volumeMode: Filesystem
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
  storageClassName: local-storage
  local:
    path: /data/models
  nodeAffinity:
    required:
      nodeSelectorTerms:
      - matchExpressions:
        - key: kubernetes.io/hostname
          operator: In
          values:
          - gpu-node-1
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: models-pvc
  namespace: llm-serving
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  storageClassName: local-storage
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 500Gi

# vllm-full.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: vllm-qwen-7b
  namespace: llm-serving
  labels:
    app: vllm
    model: qwen-7b
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: vllm
      model: qwen-7b
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: vllm
        model: qwen-7b
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        nvidia.com/gpu.present: "true"
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
          - weight: 100
            podAffinityTerm:
              labelSelector:
                matchLabels:
                  app: vllm
              topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
      containers:
      - name: vllm
        image: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.17.1
        args:
        - --model
        - /models/Qwen2-7B-Instruct
        - --host
        - "0.0.0.0"
        - --port
        - "8000"
        - --trust-remote-code
        - --gpu-memory-utilization
        - "0.9"
        - --max-model-len
        - "4096"
        - --enable-chunked-prefill
        resources:
          limits:
            nvidia.com/gpu: 1
            memory: "16Gi"
            cpu: "4"
          requests:
            memory: "8Gi"
            cpu: "2"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: models
          mountPath: /models
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8000
          name: http
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: 8000
          initialDelaySeconds: 120
          periodSeconds: 10
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: 8000
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 5
      volumes:
      - name: models
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: models-pvc
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: vllm-service
  namespace: llm-serving
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: vllm
    model: qwen-7b
  ports:
  - port: 8000
    targetPort: 8000
    name: http
